## 🎯 Quick Access by Use Case

### "I need to compile my resume PDF"
→ Use **`resume.tex`**
```bash
pdflatex resume.tex
# Or upload to Overleaf
```

### "I need to copy bullet points for an online application"
→ Use **`RESUME_BULLETS_QUANTUM.md`**

### "I want to understand what changed"
→ Use **`BEFORE_AFTER_COMPARISON.md`**

### "I need talking points for my cover letter"
→ Use **`SUMMARY.md`** (see "Next Steps" section)

### "I want to see how I match the IBM job"
→ Use **`SUMMARY.md`** or **`RESUME_BULLETS_QUANTUM.md`** (both have alignment tables)

## 🚀 Recommended Reading Order

### First Time Reviewing
1. **`SUMMARY.md`** - Get the big picture
2. **`BEFORE_AFTER_COMPARISON.md`** - See the impact
3. **`resume.tex`** - Review the actual resume
4. **`RESUME_BULLETS_QUANTUM.md`** - Reference for other uses

### When Applying to IBM
1. **`resume.tex`** - Compile and submit
2. **`SUMMARY.md`** - Review talking points
3. **`BEFORE_AFTER_COMPARISON.md`** - Prepare for interviews

### When Updating LinkedIn or Other Profiles
1. **`RESUME_BULLETS_QUANTUM.md`** - Copy bullets
2. **`SUMMARY.md`** - See key differentiators
